results.title: The Midwest Invitational Rodeo in South Bend with 3rd Generation Cowgirl Tess Leblanc
results.description: Third-generation cowgirl Tess LeBlanc joined WNDU to talk about the Midwest Invitational Rodeo coming to South Bend.

results.title: AnimEigo Rescues Out-of-Print ReLIFE and Four More Anime From Otakon Announcement
results.description: AnimEigo ReLIFE Blu-ray and four other classic anime titles — Antique Bakery, Dog of Flanders: The Movie, Ruin Explorers: Fam & Ihrie, and Welcome to Irabu's Office — were licensed at the Otakon 2026 panel, all scheduled for 2027 release, with most titles coming from out-of-print or DVD-only status after Funimation's April 2024 shutdown.
